objectives: 修習者能了解化合物半導體材料之製備技術，特有之光電特性，掌握現有化合物半導體元件之工作原理，並據此可以發展元件結構設計之能力。
content:
CH 0 Introduction
-	Typical compound semiconductors and their applications
-	Market trend and perspectives
CH 1 Structural properties of semiconductors
-	Crystal growth – bulk growth and epitaxy
-	Crystal structure
CH 2 Semiconductor band structure
-	Block theorem and crystal momentum
-	Selected band structures
-	Intrinsic carriers and doping
CH 3 Band structure modifications
-	Semiconductor alloys
-	Heterostructures
-	Strain effect
-	Polar heterostructures
CH 4 Transport properties
-	Defect and carrier-carrier scattering
-	Alloy scattering
-	Phonon scattering
CH 5 Optical properties
-	Interband and intraband transitions
-	Radiative and nonradiative recombination
-	Excitonic effects and modulation of optical properties
CH 6 Devices
-	Optical devices
-	Electronic devices
CH 7 Characterization techniques
-	Hall effect, Photoluminescence, X-ray diffraction
books:
教科書:
1. III–V Compound Semiconductors and Devices, An Introduction to Fundamentals, by Keh Yung Cheng, Springer, 2021. ISBN 978-3-030-51903-2
2. Semiconductor Material and Device Characterization, 3rd ed, by D. K Schroder, John Wiley and Sons, 2006
teaching_method:
講授
研討
實習/實驗
